title: Iran’s Isolation Grows After U.S. Imposes Sweeping Sanctions on Airlines
summary: Mahan Air, a major airline, said it would stop flying to Turkey and Oman just over a week after new restrictions were announced, adding to U.S. pressure on the economy.
